description: Workstation cluster -- premium QoS. Can the repair unit (coalition) keep BOTH sub-clusters serving forever, i.e. each sub-cluster has at least one operational workstation? Expected TRUE: the failures hit one sub-cluster per round and the repair unit can restore that same sub-cluster, so neither side is ever emptied. Stronger than the minimum QoS <rep>G{qos == 1} (total >= N); here every sub-cluster stays alive.
